  "situation": "The EPA was determining communications requirements for participating service component commands during PANAMAX 24. IANTN could provide a shared communication environment for joint force commands and vetted partner personnel, while APAN supported real-time sharing of unclassified exercise material. APAN had relatively few user-access barriers, and its request-and-approval process was quicker than that of other networks.
